51591561.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal human PD-L1 expressed in HEK293 cells assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Assay: SPR Assay. The binding affinity of compounds with mPD-L1 (S0010-M08H, Sino Biological) was examined on a Biacore S200. Briefly, human PD-L1 protein was diluted to 25 μg/mL in 10 mM sodium acetate (pH = 5.0) and then immobilized on a CMS chip for 900 s at a flow rate of 5 μL/min. Dual channels were involved in each experiment, one capturing the ligand and the other serving as a reference channel. The tested compounds were diluted with running buffer (1× HBS-EP containing 5% DMSO) to different concentrations and then injected simultaneously at a flow rate of 30 μL/min, with 60 s of association followed by 90 s of dissociation at 25 °C. The flow path was flushed with a 1X solution of 5% DMSO, and 50% DMSO was used for washing the chip surface. The K_D value was calculated using Biacore S200 Evaluation software. Similarly, hPD-L1/Fc protein (PDI-H5258, Acro Biosystems) was diluted to 25 μg/mL and then immobilized on a Series S Sensor Chip Protein A for 120 s at a flow rate of 10 μL/min. Dual channels were involved in each experiment, one capturing the ligand and the other serving as a reference channel. The tested compounds were diluted with running buffer (1× HBS-EP containing 5% DMSO) to different concentrations and then injected simultaneously at a flow rate of 30 μL/min, with 60 s of association followed by 90 s of dissociation at 25 °C. For the regeneration of surface after each cycle (one-time ligand capture and binding of analyte at a single concentration) was carried out using 10 mM glycine pH 1.5 at a flow rate of 30 μL/min for 30 s.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Figure 4. (A) Binding affinity of BMS-202 at different concentrations with mPD-L1 by SPR assay. (B) The binding affinity of X14 at different concentrations with mPD-L1 by SPR assay. (C) Effect of compound X14 on PBMCs killing MDA-MB-231 cells. Tumor cell viability was detected by LDH release. All data are displayed as mean ± SD (*P < 0.05, ***P < 0.001, ****P < 0.0001 vs PBMC group, n = 3).

analyte.concentration_range: 39 nM - 2500 nM (for BMS-202); 10 nM - 625 nM (for X14)
